maya: Quick note 1 - field wants a concise launch checklist for Private (VPC/on
prem). Need owners for acceptance tests + contract snippets.

alex: Ill own the acceptance matrix. plan: one row per customer story with verification steps + non
goal flags.

samir: ops will add upgrade playbook: canary rules, cache rewarm mitigation, autoscale cushion.

jess: security will list KMS/HSM BYOK requirements and airgap signing expectations.

maya: field asks: zero-downtime minor upgrades, optional peering/private-link, BYOK, audit log sinks, safe model rollbacks.

alex: draft verification example:
- deploy v1 -> canary 10% -> wait 30m -> p95 delta < 15% -> rollback test preserves model pin

samir: enumerate network modes: PEER, PRIVATE_LINK, NAT_PROXY, AIRGAP. each has different SLAs.

jess: airgap needs signed installer + preflight manifest. logging sinks: syslog/TLS, S3, HEC.

maya: timeline idea: 2-week matrix + contract snippets, 4-week field beta (2 anchors), 8-week GA for peering/private_link.

alex: will add contract fragment for peering responsibilities + 48h change notice.

samir: add migration harness for NAT->PEERING (route checks, smoke QPS test, connection drain).

deploy-bot: created draft doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/private-deploy/launch-checklist-draft (product,eng).

maya: thanks. Owners: alex(matrix), samir(ops), jess(security). Review Thurs sync. Drop legal redlines here by Tue EOD. :thumbsup:
